title: NearbyObjects
description: Named, interactable game objects (trees, rocks, doors, ranges, bank booths) in the scene the RuneLite client has loaded, roughly 50 tiles each way around the player. Written by the plugin to objects/<rsn>.json inside the snapshot directory, rebuilt on scene load and after object spawns or despawns. Kept apart from the character snapshot so that file stays small. Bump schemaVersion on any breaking change.

instance.description: True inside an instance (raids, some bosses and quests). Tiles are then instance coordinates, as the player's snapshot position is, and do not match wiki coordinates.

origin.description: The player's tile when the index was built.

truncated.description: True when the scene held more objects than the plugin's cap; only the ones nearest the origin were kept.

objects.description: Object name to its tiles, nearest the origin first. Each tile is [x, y, plane, objectId]; for objects larger than one tile it is the centre tile, rounded south-west.
